revision_notes: President Barrow launched the National Identity Management System (NIMS/GAM ID) and a National Data Centre on 1 July 2026, establishing a unified biometric National Identity Register for all citizens 18+, corroborated by multiple independent outlets (The Standard, Biometric Update, Voice Gambia, ~1-6 July 2026).
